summary.interpretation: False negatives occur when anomalous sessions exhibit feature values overlapping with normal traffic distribution, particularly in flow duration and byte count - the model's top predictive features. This indicates sophisticated attacks that closely mimic normal timing patterns remain the hardest to detect.
